_note: Portable materials library. Numbers are first-order; everything tagged TO-VERIFY/TO-MEASURE in the site outputs. Add a material here and every site can use it.

volcanic_ash.note: natural pozzolan; the original Roman ingredient

rice_husk_ash.note: reactive when burned ~500-700 C: grey/white ash good, black = unburned carbon, overburned (>~800 C) = crystalline silica (lung hazard, less reactive)

calcined_clay.note: needs kaolinite-rich clay (threshold TO-VERIFY); only 5-15% of wall mass, can be hauled

fly_ash.note: coal-plant byproduct; supply shrinking as plants close (TO-VERIFY)

quicklime_hot_mix.hazard: caustic, exothermic, can spit steam; goggles, gloves, respirator

hydrated_lime.note: safer, no heat; works on clayey soils, better with a pozzolan

solar_electric.note: needs ~20 kW array for the build; weather-limited
